recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中紅血球大多單獨分散，但散在數個由 2 至 5 顆紅血球互相重疊形成的不規則小團塊，並非直線的錢串狀；此圖的凝集程度輕微，需與抹片製作造成的重疊區分。
features: Mostly dispersed normocytic red cells with scattered small irregular clumps of 2-5 overlapping RBCs
Clumps are irregular rather than linear coin stacks
Occasional platelets; no spherocytes or schistocytes clearly identified
Agglutination is subtle in this field
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows predominantly dispersed normocytic red cells with scattered small, irregular aggregates of two to five overlapping erythrocytes, without linear rouleaux formation. A mature lymphocyte and scattered platelets are present. No definite spherocytes are identified in this field. The findings are suggestive of mild red cell agglutination; because the degree is subtle, correlation with warming of the sample, a direct antiglobulin test, and cold agglutinin titer is advised.

ddx.vs: Rouleaux are linear stacks of red cells associated with increased fibrinogen or paraprotein, rather than irregular clusters.

ddx.dx: Random overlap in a thick area
ddx.vs: Artifactual overlap is limited to the thick part of the smear and involves regularly overlapping pairs, while true agglutinates persist at the feathered edge.
Warm AIHA shows spherocytes and polychromasia with an IgG-positive DAT, rather than agglutinates.
